final: WITH counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS average_share FROM counts), ranked AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - average_share AS share_difference, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - average_share DESC) AS position FROM shares WHERE share > average_share) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC
